description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named TimesheetSearchFilterParams used for filtering timesheet data in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes properties for date range and employee number, with corresponding getter and setter methods, and extends a base FilterParams class.

classes.name: TimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for timesheet search filters, including date range and employee number, with sorting capability.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for filtering the timesheets.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for filtering the timesheets.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for filtering the timesheets.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for filtering the timesheets.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
